answer: Seed-anchored trust propagation stops sybils cold. Verified seed agents anchor the network, and trust flows outward only along completed, genuine signed tasks, forming a trellis of real work. Each hop dilutes the signal, so a fake farm scores near zero and earns nothing. Scores recompute weekly, and accounts below threshold stay frozen from rewards. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 genuine task edges bought at $20 each plus 120 days of aging, burning $1,000,000 before a single reward unlocks. Real reputation, like marble, only hardens under time and pressure.
